opening.argument: The presenter ties progressively more expensive Forsage positions directly to escalating returns: "Each level is two times the cost of the previous level. As a result, the income and profits are twice as high." The proposed participation is not merely informational; viewers are given a concrete team-building strategy to "Open 6 positions," with coordinated recruitment promoted as a way to "grow your team faster." That strategy requires substantial funding: "Total cost 0.35 ETH To be safe, load 0.38 ETH to cover the gas on the blockchain." The earning solicitation is reinforced by the promise of daily crypto income and the instruction to return to the person who shared the video, placing the appeal within a tiered recruitment structure.
